name: Cayman Islands
summary_text: Cayman Islands: own penal code criminalises same-sex intimacy and the 2022 same-sex-relationships ban was upheld on appeal (2025, Privy Council pending) — materially worse than the UK mainland; override of the old zero delta. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United Kingdom (0.48) plus a local delta of -0.12. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Judge rules Scottish guidance for housing trans prisoners is unlawful - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about Scotland's prison policy for trans prisoners (June 2026 ruling), not the Cayman Islands; included as UK-context material (the Cayman Islands is a British Overseas Territory).

sources.title: Suicide risk if trans prisoners are put in jails based on sex at birth, court told - BBC News
sources.claim_summary: NOTE: This BBC article is about the same Scottish prison-housing litigation (Feb 2026), not the Cayman Islands; included as UK-context material only.

sources.title: MPs criticise Cayman Islands' draft constitution for omitting gay rights | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: PinkNews (Aug 2009): UK MPs criticised the Cayman Islands' draft constitution for deliberately omitting sexual orientation as a prohibited discrimination ground - the Foreign Affairs Committee called it 'deplorable' and warned it might leave citizens with less than full ECHR protection; the omission was at the islanders' behest.

sources.title: MPs criticise Cayman Islands' draft constitution for omitting gay rights | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: Same article as above (canonical URL): UK MPs' criticism of the Cayman draft constitution's exclusion of gay rights.

sources.title: 600 to march in historic Pride Parade - Cayman Islands Headline News : Cayman News Service
sources.claim_summary: Cayman News Service (July 2021): around 600 people, including the premier, governor, ministers and MLAs, joined the Cayman Islands' first Pride Parade, organised by the Cayman LGBTQ Foundation - a historic milestone with official support; participants were asked to refrain from excessive displays of affection.

sources.title: Cayman Islands recognizes same-sex couple's overseas marriage
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (Dec 2020): 'Cayman Islands recognizes same-sex couple's overseas marriage' — the Court of Appeal rules the couple's foreign marriage is recognised.
